metadata.coverage_preamble: The day holds the Monday ink, the bill at the inn, the talk after Titus, and the packet on the desk.

yesterday: Your horn was half full. The ink is twopence the horn when it wants filling.
You are in Fair Em tomorrow at two. Rehearsal is at nine. On the way you mean to ask Richard Field whether a chronicle might be spared when Lent comes.
Heminges takes Nick to Cheapside tomorrow and will call when the mercer has named a price.
Edith's eight shillings stay as they were, and the Queen's twenty pounds stay at Whitehall. Neither of those is news from today.
The letter is still on the desk. Thursday.
